message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise‑complaint with the City of Atlanta’s local authorities. In Atlanta, noise complaints are handled by the **City of Atlanta Department of Public Safety** (specifically the **Noise Control Division**). ### How to file a complaint | Method | Details | |--------|---------| | **Online** | Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website and use the “Report a Noise Complaint” form.
URL: https://www.atlantaga.gov/department-of-public-safety/noise-control | | **Phone** | Call the Noise Control Division at **(404) 656‑4000** (or the general City of Atlanta hotline at (404) 656‑4000 and ask to be directed to Noise Control). | | **In‑person** | You can also visit the City Hall or the local police precinct to file a written complaint. | | **Email** | Send an email to noisecontrol@atlantaga.gov with details of the complaint. | ### What information to provide - Your name and contact information (optional but helpful for follow‑up). - The address or location of the noise source. - Date, time, and duration of the disturbance. - Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs). - Any relevant evidence (audio recordings, photos, or witness statements). ### Follow‑up After filing, the Noise Control Division will investigate and may issue a warning or citation if the noise violates city ordinances. If you do not receive a response within a few days, you can call the hotline to check on the status of your complaint. Feel free to let me know if you need help locating the specific ordinance or if you’d like a template for writing the complaint.
